items.name: Terraforma
items.why: Experimental music festival in Villa Arconati's park: sound installations and long-form listening fit the DREAMeSCAPE.

items.name: Club To Club
items.why: Italy's reference for forward-looking electronic and avant-pop; a stage for crossover live sets.

items.name: Romaeuropa Festival
items.why: Multidisciplinary festival (music, dance, theatre, digital) — the natural home for an 'architect of emotions'.

items.name: La Biennale di Venezia — Musica
items.why: Contemporary music sector with Biennale College calls for young composers and performers.

items.name: MITO SettembreMusica
items.why: Large classical/contemporary festival with piano recitals and new commissions.

items.name: Ravenna Festival
items.why: Interdisciplinary summer festival mixing music, theatre and dance in historic sites.

items.name: Flussi
items.why: Digital arts and electronic music festival — sound installation and audiovisual work.

items.name: Unsound
items.why: Adventurous music festival with commissioned audiovisual and installation projects.

items.name: CTM Festival
items.why: Adventurous music & art festival with exhibitions and open calls (e.g. radio lab).

items.name: Sónar+D
items.why: Creativity & technology congress inside Sónar — fits the launcher/app suite and the installation.

items.name: Auditorium Parco della Musica
items.why: Rome's main music venue, with contemporary and crossover programming.

items.name: Triennale Milano
items.why: Design/art institution with a live music and performance programme (Triennale Estate, FOG).

items.name: Pirelli HangarBicocca
items.why: Large-scale installation space; immersive sound works fit its programme.

items.name: Fondazione Merz
items.why: Contemporary art foundation with sound and performance projects.

items.name: Galleria Continua
items.why: International gallery born in Tuscany, open to installation and performance.

items.name: Erased Tapes
items.why: Home of modern-classical/piano-electronic artists (Nils Frahm, Ólafur Arnalds) — close to your piano pieces.

items.name: Mercury KX
items.why: Label for post-classical and piano-led crossover music.

items.name: Sonic Pieces
items.why: Small label for intimate piano and ambient records with crafted physical editions.

items.name: Mikey Rukus
items.why: AEW's in-house composer: the living wrestling-music crossover — ideal for the book or a collaboration.

items.name: All Elite Wrestling (AEW)
items.why: Wrestling promotion that commissions entrance music; pitch the wrestling × music idea.
